text_block_list.text:
Christmas Eve... Thoughts of various foods 
cross my mind.

Fried chicken, turkey, meatloaf, and 
Christmas cake.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, it's dinner time~. Today we're 
having oden♪
(CRASH-BANG!)

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: ...? Is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Ah, excuse me. It was just so cold.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It was cold enough outside that it felt 
like everything would freeze over, after 
all...

It's certainly cold today. Looks like this 
was Super Creek's own way of being 
thoughtful.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, do people really always want to eat 
cake on Christmas?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"I used to wonder back then... if it 
really was indispensable."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Umm... It was when I was helping out at my 
family's daycare and took the kids to the 
park...

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
"Hmph! I don't even care if Mommy doesn't 
come pick me up!"

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
"It's just—! I wanted to eat Christmas 
cake! That's all it was!"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I honestly don't think she wanted cake in 
the first place.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
As long as we can just share a nice 
Christmas meal together as a family, 
that's enough for me.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
And so~, I decided to make oden, but what 
do you think?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I thought that maybe this way would make 
you happier, Trainer.
choice_data_list: I think I'll gladly take it.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you very much~ Shall we get 
under the kotatsu and eat, then?

On a night when everyone else was digging 
into cake, for some reason, the two of us 
were digging into oden.

"Still, maybe this is what it means to be 
on the same wavelength."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the meal~. Did you get full, 
Trainer-san?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Thank goodness. Now then, for after-dinner 
sweets...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I'll go bring the Christmas cake~.
(CRASH-BANG!)

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: ...? Is something the matter?
I didn't expect them to appear here.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Thank you for the meal~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Um, Trainer. May I ask you one more thing?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I said earlier that the food doesn't 
matter as long as we spend Christmas 
together, but...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Does that include their social standing 
too?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Yes. If we weren't a Trainer and an 
Umamusume...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"Did you still want to spend Christmas 
together?"

I think for a while. However, no answer 
comes to mind.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Um, Trainer?
choice_data_list: What do you think, Super Creek?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Me...? Well, as for me... hmm.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I wonder about that. I feel like... maybe 
I don't even need to think about it♪

The room is filled with warmth. Let us 
leave the conversation at that for now.
